issues.title: Dangling External References (Truncation)
issues.why: The module relies on 50+ external NN-*.md files for normative script logic, but these are truncated in the provided context, leaving the AI with only the overview and module-level ACs.
issues.fix: The Slot Delegation Map (AC-T-30) and AC Family Prefix Index (AC-T-31) are provided in §97 to mitigate this; ensure the AI is instructed to treat these indices as the source of truth for delegated logic.

issues.title: Missing Concrete Implementation for R2 Snippets
issues.why: AC-T-32 mandates normative code snippets for R2 file-locking retries in §00, but the provided context ends before these snippets are visible or they are referenced but not inlined in the overview.
issues.fix: Incorporate the Python/Node R2 retry snippets directly into the §00 Resilience section as promised by the AC.

issues.title: Concurrency/Locking Implementation Ambiguity
issues.why: While R1 (atomic writes) is well-defined, R2 (torn reads) relies on a 3x retry logic that is described but lacks the specific jitter/back-off implementation details in the prose.
issues.fix: Explicitly define the jitter calculation (e.g., 100ms * (0.75 + random() * 0.5)) in the R2 prose.
